'''Hierotyrus''' is a [[Rock]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Zenscarab]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Hierotyrus's tastes have transcended the bounds of the ordinary world. The signature favorite has now crystalized into a triangular talisman embedded with a mysterious eye; when held high, not only does it expose the weakness of all within view, but also delivers the swiftest judgement of annihilation."

Hierotyrus is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.
